cta_schedule_reference.query:
run: scheduled_service -> {
    where: service_date >= @2026-11-02, service_date <= @2026-11-15
    where: route_id = "22" or route_id = "49" or route_id = "79" or route_id = "9" or route_id = "Blue" or route_id = "Red"
    group_by: service_date, route_id
    aggregate: total_scheduled_trips
    order_by: service_date asc, route_id asc
  }
